status: unadopted; native/runtime metering and containment unqualified

accounting.simultaneous: All inclusive limits apply together, including stricter dependency-stage caps; maxima are not a promise they fit simultaneously
accounting.rows: Every received native row occurrence including overlap, denied rights and ACL sentinel rows counts; scheduling dedup never rebates observations
accounting.bytes: Original transport, decoded copies, raw archives, private ledger/frontier/edges, canonical basis and encoded publication remain owned until independently released
accounting.work: Charge every native query invocation, actual selected native work and every scanned/visited/copied/decoded/encoded/hashed/compared byte/occurrence; lengths cannot estimate native work
accounting.permits: Precharge materialization/transport/decoded/output and bounded native workload before dispatch; no query receives a new global allowance
accounting.failure: Stop new admission on first exhaustion; no partial basis or complete scope; retain original evidence and termination/recovery custody under existing contracts

scope: Complete native collector invocation only; generation, installation mutations, Weft compilation and later recovery have separate explicit profiles and cannot borrow unused collector capacity
